subject: The 3-minute routine that changed my writing
preview_text: How a 3-minute habit made Thesis Generator 10x more effective for students like you.
body_paragraphs: Remember staring at a blank page for hours, the panic building as the deadline crept closer? That was me last semester. Then I stumbled on a 3-minute routine that made Thesis Generator 10x more effective. It's not about working harder—it's about using the right 180 seconds every day.

Here's the trick: open the app, type your topic into the thesis generator, and set a timer for exactly 3 minutes. No editing, no overthinking. Just raw ideas. That small habit loop—trigger, action, reward—rewires your brain to see the app as your go-to tool for instant progress. Consistency beats intensity every time.

The feature that makes this stick is the instant thesis statement. It frees you from that first blank page paralysis. One click, and you have a focused argument you can build on. That's the loop: open app, get thesis, feel relief. Do it daily, and you'll never dread starting again.

Try this now: open Thesis Generator and generate one thesis statement in under 3 minutes. That's all. See how it feels. P.S. Students who do this daily see grades jump from B+ to A- in weeks. Your 3-minute habit starts today.
